explanation: Encodes 'is f(n) ≥ n/4?' (for all n) and negates it. Dúcz–Varga (arXiv:2606.28157) construct a finite planar unit-distance graph with independence ratio strictly below 1/4, and I confirmed this from the arXiv abstract, which explicitly says it answers Erdős's question. Taking X to be its vertex set gives f(|X|) < |X|/4, so the negation is correct. The definition of f (any n distinct points, with independence measured in the exact-distance-1 graph) matches erdosproblems.com/1070.
